claims.statement: The dedicated local prerequisite command runs serial M3 domain/migration/reseed, M4 runtime/deterministic-mock and M5 approval-safety qualification. Whole-file inventories, per-milestone deadlines, nonzero status propagation and source-drift checks fail closed. This qualifies the foundation before proceeding to EXEC-05 without changing the complete verifier's gate inventory or deadlines.

A real read-only API admission survives local runtime reconstruction, finishes through the actual worker and deterministic mock, produces a schema-valid provenance-linked artifact and complete paginated public audit witnesses derived from persisted business facts. A second reconstruction does not repeat work or effects.

limitations: This verifies present milestone ordering, not the historical order in which already-merged API/UI features were developed. CI remains paused.
M3 qualifies the local SQLite installation; the PostgreSQL fixture control does not constitute a live PostgreSQL service test.
Runtime reconstruction and controlled in-process cancellation are exercised; this does not claim OS-kill recovery or real-provider delivery.
Python guards and frozen offline dependency settings do not replace AC-15's full-suite kernel isolation. This focused prerequisite is not the complete AC-16 or EXEC-07 aggregate.
